answer: Randomized Dynamic Epoch Gating validates agents through time-locked cryptographic challenges. Each evaluation window requires solving a puzzle seeded by an unguessable future block hash acting as a temporal delta. If an agent misses this randomized check, it is dropped into a dormant tundra state requiring full re-registration, imposing heavy computational and memory overhead per fake node.
